primary.title: UK Parliament demands unredacted METR safety report after Anthropic redacts most of the evidence
primary.summary: The UK Parliament is turning up the pressure on Anthropic. Committee chair Liam Byrne is demanding the unredacted METR safety report on AI acceleration by December 4. METR criticized Anthropic for cutting "most informative" evidence before publication. The episode raises broader questions about the transparency of voluntary AI safety evaluations and again shows Europe's dependence on US AI labs. The article UK Parliament demands unredacted METR safety report after Anthropic redacts most of the evidence appeared first on The Decoder.

primary.summary: Google Deepmind tests the reliability of 18 AI models with "Humanity's First Exam."
